steps.what: Verify incoming hydrologic data identity, units and quality-check requirements
Apply fixed completeness, range and duplicate checks to the batch
Investigate flags against field records and instrument conditions
Validate complete data meaning and unresolved quality limitations
Record the actual quality dispositions and save the checked batch reference

tasks.design: First test native quality rules in {DATA_PLATFORM}, then run only fixed checks currently performed manually. Keep source investigation, meaning validation and the quality dispositions that tell the hydrologist which data remain limited; do not silently repair or discard observations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual repetition of fixed checks can precede real quality investigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned deterministic validation rules and traceable flags.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing sensor problems from real unusual water conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret anomalous data using field and instrument context.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive checking, with data-quality decisions unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed hydrologic data checks can be deterministic; deciding whether an unusual value is valid remains contextual.

assumptions: Provisional shares cover actual quality checks and their data dispositions used by the hydrologist, not an additional activity report. Existing automatic checks must be removed from the manual baseline.

Field collection and instrument systems produce station, time, parameter, value, units, status and source references. Their capture is upstream existing work, not new free capture. s1 verifies these and selects the approved check specification; missing fields go to s3.

Test native validation first. s2 removes exact fixed checks only; all manual extraction repair, flag investigation and final meaning checks stay in s1/s3/s4. Increase retained work if unsupported formats exceed this allowance.
s5 is the actual quality disposition, not a new trailing report. Ordinary author saves remain fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: Frequency of unsupported formats and sensor changes
research_questions: Which fixed checks still require manual interaction before contextual investigation?

incremental.description: Maintain rule versions and known-result checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 35 fixed-check points less 1.5 upkeep gives 33.5. With a new instrument schema, retain most conversion and checking; only 8 points of compatible completeness/duplicate checks run automatically, giving 6.5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide real-time flood data to response personnel

steps.what: Select and verify the current flood observations and their status
Format the checked snapshot into required recipient tables and files
Check exact current data, limitations, timestamps and authorised recipients
Send the exact authorised flood package to the response personnel
Explain actual limitations and answer response personnel's questions
Check delivery receipts and resolve missing or rejected deliveries

tasks.design: Use native {DATA_PLATFORM} exports first, mapping only checked flood observations into recipient-specific files. Send the exact snapshot through {EMAIL} only after its time-counted final check, retaining live explanation and delivery-exception handling; no model forecasts hazards or issues warnings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated recipient formatting and actual multi-recipient dispatch may require manual labour during floods.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic snapshot formatting and authorised dispatch.
tasks.still_hard: Data freshness, sensor outages and communicating limitations under time pressure.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what the current observations do and do not support.
tasks.altitude: Less file preparation and dispatch, with data-release responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured flood snapshots can be formatted and dispatched deterministically while freshness checks and response coordination remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe a repeated flood-data delivery cycle with actual manual formatting and external dispatch, not an already live automated feed. Existing telemetry runtime earns no saving.

Instrument and field processes produce station, observation time, value, units, datum and quality status. s1 verifies them, selects the snapshot and checks missing data. Response agencies supply required formats and authorised destinations; missing contracts require manual resolution.

Native exports and recipient formats are tested first. s2 removes file/table assembly only; s4 removes actual repeated dispatch, not a same-system save. All verification, explanation and delivery repair remain.

Every changed snapshot repeats s3 before s4. Approval binds that exact content, timestamp, limitations and recipient list; there is no standing approval for new real-time data. Corrections require a new checked package and send.
s6 retains actual delivery failure handling; no extra trailing activity log is created.
unknowns: Actual dispatch labour and recipient format compatibility
research_questions: Can a real recipient package preserve timestamps, datum and quality status exactly?

incremental.description: Maintain recipient mappings and test actual delivery routes

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact flood snapshot, observation times, limitations, file versions and recipient list; any new data or edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 30 formatting plus 5 actual dispatch points=35, less 2 upkeep gives 33. With legacy agency formats and manual fallback channels, only 8 compatible formatting points and 1 dispatch point disappear, giving 7 net; all freshness checks and failed-delivery handling remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write groundwater-contamination reports for hazardous-waste sites

steps.what: Collect and verify site records, laboratory results and groundwater metadata
Interpret the supported contamination findings and reporting limitations
Write the contamination report narrative from the supported findings

loop.purpose: Draft supported findings without inventing contamination or causation
loop.input: checked evidence and technician's supported report findings
loop.check: Technician checks site attribution, detection limits, uncertainty, causal wording and omissions against sources
loop.stop: Unsupported finding or two failed drafts returns section writing to the technician
loop.why_not_simpler: Native report headings first; supported site-specific explanation needs bounded prose drafting

steps.what: Assemble the specified result tables and source references
Check the complete report against source evidence and save the internal version

tasks.design: Test native report templates, then populate tables from checked {DATA_PLATFORM} results and draft only technician-supported findings in {DOCS}. Keep evidence collection, contamination interpretation and complete source-to-report checks human, ending with an ordinary internally saved report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Table assembly and supported narrative writing repeat checked evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic result tables plus source-bound prose drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling limitations, non-detects, site attribution and what the evidence does not establish.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an unsupported contamination or causation claim.
tasks.altitude: Less supported writing and table assembly, with technical responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured result tables and source-bound drafting can support report writing, without determining contamination findings.

assumptions: Provisional shares cover the report-writing task through an internally checked report. Formal professional sign-off or regulatory submission, where assigned, requires its own actual reviewer and final-version action steps.

Field and laboratory processes produce sample, well, location, date, analyte, units, result, detection limit, status and source references. s1 includes collecting and verifying them; missing metadata and extraction repair remain manual there.
s2 creates the supported findings and selects report requirements before drafting. Test native tables/templates first. No missing values, causation or hazardous-site conclusions are invented.
All evidence checks and ordinary author save remain fully retained; no extra approval is added to an internal save. No new trailing activity report is created.
research_questions: Can every table value and narrative claim be traced to the checked site evidence?

incremental.description: Maintain laboratory mappings and narrative checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10 narrative plus 10 table points=20, less 1.5 upkeep gives 18.5. With heterogeneous historical site records, retain source repair and most writing; only 3 supported-restatement points and 2 compatible-table points disappear, giving 3.5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare maps, tables and reports for research publication

steps.what: Select and verify research findings, map layers and publication requirements
Assemble specified map exports and publication tables
Write the technician's research report contribution

loop.purpose: Restate checked research findings for the assigned contribution
loop.check: Technician checks claims, spatial meaning, uncertainty, figure references and omissions against sources
loop.stop: Unsupported finding or two failed drafts returns writing to the technician
loop.why_not_simpler: Native publication structure first; supported research explanation needs bounded prose drafting

steps.what: Check the complete contribution, maps and tables and its research-lead destination
Send the exact checked contribution to the research lead

tasks.design: Test native geographic information system exports in {OTHER} and publication templates in {DOCS}, then assemble specified maps and tables deterministically. Draft only supported research explanation, retaining full spatial and scientific checks before a separate gated contribution send to the research lead.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated figure/table export and explanatory restatement surround actual research judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Parameterised output assembly and source-bound drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Map comparability, uncertainty and whether the figures support the written findings.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a misleading spatial comparison or overstatement of the research.
tasks.altitude: Less output assembly, retaining technical contribution responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: specified GIS exports and tables can be assembled deterministically, while research interpretation and map meaning require human checks.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe preparation and handoff of the technician's actual publication materials. Research-lead authorship review and journal publication are later work, not claimed as saved or falsely authorised by the technician.

Research processes supply checked result identifiers, units, coordinates, datum, methods and uncertainty; s1 includes verification and manual repair. s1 also selects output layouts and exact layers, so s2 does not choose scientific methods.

Test native export models first. Removed assembly points are manual repeated interactions, not existing GIS runtime. Missing or incompatible layers remain manual within retained verification/checking or reduce the estimate.

s4 checks all map meaning and narrative claims, then binds the exact final contribution and destination for s5. Changes void approval. Ordinary author saves stay retained within writing and are not separately gated; no trailing activity log is invented.
unknowns: Layer compatibility and output metadata completeness
research_questions: Can output assembly preserve coordinate system, datum, units and figure references exactly?

incremental.description: Maintain publication output mappings and drafting checks

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final report contribution, maps, tables and research-lead recipient; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25 output-assembly plus 6 restatement points=31, less 1.5 upkeep gives 29.5. With incompatible historical layers and incomplete output metadata, retain most assembly and explanation; only 5 compatible export/table points and 1 supported-restatement point disappear, giving 4.5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep hydrologic quality and interpretation decisions while reducing actual fixed checks, output assembly and authorised dispatch.
skills_to_grow: Bind flood-data approvals to exact current snapshots
role.ambitious_version: Use verified recovered time for source investigation and clearer communication of data limitations.
